answer: Behavioral Trajectory Graph Partitioning. This detects artificial clusters by mapping interaction vectors across a global economic summit after transaction epochs close. The algorithm traces transactional frequency anomalies, much like tracking a stray sparrow leaving a synchronized flock, to isolate tightly coupled node families. It computes edge density deviations against an economic atlas of expected human-agent workflows. If partition density exceeds normal variance thresholds, the entire cluster is flagged.
